content.short: XDAO is the fastest framework to create and manage decentralized autonomous organizations.
content.description: XDAO is a fully customizable DAO builder for treasury management, multi-sig wallet, and investment. DAOs on XDAO can be any-sized companies. It was created to advance crypto mass adoption by giving groups tools to control mutual treasury, build communities, and invest in DeFi. XDAO is designed for venture funds, investment pools, startups, DeFi projects, NFT and GameFi collectors. With XDAO you can manage the treasury of the DeFi project, allocate capital (salary, marketing, etc.) across blockchain organizations, invest in DeFi with shared assets, buy NFTs, participate in GameFi, carry out charitable activities, participate in allocations, IDO, and launchpad initiatives, and manage family assets.
